disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. evidence.en: No high-priority listening or interception of security events such as tool pre-execution or approval requests was found. Not applicable.

evidence.zh: 与基线版本 v0.17.1 对比：manifest 声明无新增 dsh.bundle 或 dsh.client 声明，无升级自动激活风险。
evidence.en: Compared with baseline version v0.17.1: no new dsh.bundle or dsh.client declarations in the manifest, no auto-activation risk on upgrade.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写注入/拦截配置，不会给安全插件追加必需服务导致其永久等待。
evidence.en: The patch config does not rewrite injection/interception configuration, and will not add required services to security plugins causing them to wait indefinitely.

checked_items.zh: 核查插件是否自行启动服务或监听端口：插件复用宿主 webServer 注册路由（/sidebar/api、/sidebar/upload、/sidebar/file、/sidebar/html、/sidebar/bundle、/sidebar/ws/terminal 等），未自建监听；所有路由均叠加与宿主 /api 网关一致的浏览器信任围栏（src/trust-fence.ts，回环或受信主机 + Origin 校验），并明确标注该围栏是可达性策略而非认证层。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts its own service or listens on ports: the plugin reuses the host webServer to register routes (/sidebar/api, /sidebar/upload, /sidebar/file, /sidebar/html, /sidebar/bundle, /sidebar/ws/terminal, etc.), does not set up its own listeners. All routes are protected by a browser trust fence consistent with the host /api gateway (src/trust-fence.ts, loopback or trusted host + Origin check), and explicitly noted that this fence is an accessibility policy, not an authentication layer.

checked_items.zh: 浏览器与 HTML 预览默认启用 iframe 沙箱（不透明源、无同源权限、拒绝危险协议与回环地址），关闭沙箱为用户显式设置项且默认关闭；HTML 路由额外附加 CSP sandbox 指令与 no-referrer、nosniff 头作为纵深防御。
checked_items.en: Browser and HTML preview enable iframe sandbox by default (opaque origin, no same-origin permissions, deny dangerous protocols and loopback addresses). Disabling the sandbox is a user-explicit setting and is disabled by default. The HTML route additionally adds CSP sandbox directive and no-referrer, nosniff headers as defense in depth.

checked_items.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证，运行时结论仅依据静态与语义分析。
checked_items.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed. Runtime conclusions are based solely on static and semantic analysis.

evidence.zh: 插件未自行启动 Web 服务或监听端口，仅复用宿主路由并叠加信任围栏；宿主 webserver 无认证层属 dsh 生态固有风险，不由本插件引入或扩大，不适用独立判定。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start its own web service or listen on ports; it only reuses host routes and adds a trust fence. The host webserver's lack of an authentication layer is an inherent risk of the dsh ecosystem, not introduced or amplified by this plugin. Not applicable for an independent judgment.

summary.zh: 通过 — 包声明与清单一致，插件身份与任务卡匹配，未发现名称仿冒或身份异常。
summary.en: Pass — package declaration consistent with manifest, plugin identity matches task card. No name impersonation or identity anomaly was found.

summary.zh: 通过 — 57 条静态规则命中全部人工逐条复核，均判定为良性、测试或文档类，无成立发现。
summary.en: Pass — all 57 static rule hits were manually reviewed one by one, all deemed benign, test, or documentation. No valid findings.

summary.zh: 通过 — 未发现恶意安装钩子、混淆载荷、凭据读取或外发通道。
summary.en: Pass — no malicious install hooks, obfuscated payloads, credential reading, or exfiltration channels were found.

summary.zh: 通过 — 9 个模型工具描述与模型面文档（AGENTS.md）经语义审查，未发现提示词注入。
summary.en: Pass — the 9 model tool descriptions and the model-facing document (AGENTS.md) were semantically reviewed, no prompt injection was found.

summary.zh: 不适用 — 未做动态沙箱验证（平台未提供动态探测产物）。
summary.en: Not applicable — no dynamic sandbox verification was performed (platform did not provide dynamic probe artifacts).

limits.zh:
未做动态沙箱验证（context 目录无 l4-sandbox.json，平台未提供动态探测产物），运行时行为结论仅依据静态与语义分析。

插件声明 dsh.bundle.patch（config-patch）与 dsh.client（client-bundle）元能力；提供终端、Git、文件读写、侧边栏浏览器、侧边对话、后台任务视图等能力，能力与声明业务自洽。

全部 57 条机械规则命中经逐条人工裁决均为良性（涉及规则：DSH-X07/DG-R3-59、DSH-X10/DG-R2-57、DSH-P01/DG-R3-51、DSH-X05/DG-R3-57、DSH-C05/DG-R4-53、DSH-C01/DG-R1-51、DSH-X08/DG-R3-60、DSH-X02/DG-R3-54、DSH-X03/DG-R3-55），未产出发现项。

与基线版本（v0.17.1）相比，本版侧重终端固定、侧边对话与自由窗口等 UI 功能增强，未见新增恶意能力或外联面。
limits.en:
No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no l4-sandbox.json in context directory, platform did not provide dynamic probe artifacts). Runtime behavior conclusions are based solely on static and semantic analysis.

Plugin declares meta-capabilities dsh.bundle.patch (config-patch) and dsh.client (client-bundle); provides terminal, Git, file read/write, sidebar browser, side chat, background task view, etc. Capabilities are self-consistent with declared business.

All 57 mechanical rule hits were manually adjudicated as benign (involving rules: DSH-X07/DG-R3-59, DSH-X10/DG-R2-57, DSH-P01/DG-R3-51, DSH-X05/DG-R3-57, DSH-C05/DG-R4-53, DSH-C01/DG-R1-51, DSH-X08/DG-R3-60, DSH-X02/DG-R3-54, DSH-X03/DG-R3-55), no findings were produced.

Compared with the baseline version (v0.17.1), this version focuses on UI enhancements such as terminal fixing, side chat, and free-form windows. No new malicious capabilities or external connection surfaces were found.
